ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with a contrast ratio of approximately 92:8 relative to the high-intensity (white) scarring and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-contrast white contiguous blobs are located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Multiple discrete, high-contrast white circular rings are mapped across the mid-ventral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 145 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The boundary displays low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations concentrated on the lateral thirds of the lobes, with a smoother, continuous topography toward the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a complex curve transitioning from a gentle convexity near the notch to a distinct concavity approaching the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white spots (barnacles) localized at the far-left and far-right tips. Distinct individual white circular rings are scattered across the interior fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, vertical white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the lateral portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at fluke extremities; circular ring-shaped scarring consistent with parasitic interaction; vertical rake marks on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and symmetrical distribution of circular 'O-ring' scars across the ventral surface of both fluke lobes.
